body.x: IT Health (CEO Bae Yoon-sub, www.ithealth.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center,unveiled 'UrineCare' at '2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after 'CES 2013') held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11

'UrinCare' is a smartphone-based management system built in urine sensor developed by own technology. It can be useful in homes, nursing homes or hospitals. In case of the elderly who has difficult with handling feces, it can help the elderly by automatically sending guardian or the nurse information.
The company officials said " We are so glad to show our system in CES 2013, Especially pharmaceutical companies showed their interest to our company in this exhibition."

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
